summary: Google Auth (Emergent-managed OAuth) integration verified end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_google_auth.py — POST /api/auth/google with an invalid session_id returns 401 with detail 'Invalid Google session' (verified against real https://demobackend.emergentagent.com/auth/v1/env/oauth/session-data host), missing session_id returns 422, empty string is rejected, endpoint requires no Bearer auth, and email/password regression (signup + signin + /me for test@christcalm.app) still works. Frontend (390x844 web preview): sign-in screen renders Google button with testID='google-signin-btn' and label 'Sign in with Google' above 'OR CONTINUE WITH EMAIL' divider; sign-up screen renders 'Sign up with Google' above 'OR SIGN UP WITH EMAIL' divider. Clicking the Google button on web sets window.location.href to EXACTLY https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fcalm-faith-app-2.preview.emergentagent.com%2F — matches spec character-for-character. URL-hash handling: loading the app with '#session_id=invalid-abc-xyz' triggered AuthContext to POST /api/auth/google on mount, backend correctly returned 401 'Invalid Google session', AuthContext caught the error (console: 'Google session exchange failed Error: Invalid Google session'), cleaned the URL (no session_id in final URL), and routed to /sign-in with no crash and no user session — exactly the expected behavior. Deprecated packages detected: none new (only pre-existing shadow* / pointerEvents warnings from iteration_2, non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing (iteration_2). Console still warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme shadow presets.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:234-295 — /api/auth/google flow is correct: httpx GET to EMERGENT_SESSION_URL with X-Session-ID header, non-200 => 401 'Invalid Google session', upsert by email into users collection, mints normal JWT via create_token(user_id). Google-only users have password_hash=None, provider='google'. On subsequent logins, name is only overwritten for Google-only users (not for hybrid users with a password) — good.
AuthContext.tsx:59-75 — loginWithGoogleSessionId is idempotent via processedSessionIds ref set, preventing double-submit if the URL is re-processed.

AuthContext.tsx:84-99 — On web mount, extractSessionId reads from window.location.hash first then search; URL is cleaned via history.replaceState BEFORE the exchange call (so a failed exchange doesn't leave the session_id in the URL). Verified working end-to-end.

GoogleSignInButton.tsx:42-47 — Web navigation URL construction uses window.location.origin + '/' as the redirect target and URL-encodes it correctly. Verified: outbound URL was 'https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fcalm-faith-app-2.preview.emergentagent.com%2F'.
api/client.ts:52-53 — googleAuth() correctly uses auth:false so no Bearer header is sent; body is {session_id}.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Google button + divider on both screens, correct outbound redirect URL, invalid session_id handled gracefully with no crash)

seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed users via /api/auth/signup during regression test. No production data touched. No real Google user could be created because the OAuth callback cannot be automated without a Google account.
